original_benchmark.notes: Research split of HF openai/frontierscience (60 rows, 59 unique problems; rows 6 and 11 are an exact duplicate). Each problem has a 10-point expert rubric graded by an LLM judge. OpenAI released no evaluation harness; inspect_evals/frontierscience is the closest public implementation.

harbor_adapter.notes: All 60 rows are kept, including the duplicate (second copy suffixed -2), to match inspect_evals. reward.json carries reward (1 if judge points >= 7, the paper's criterion) and score (points / 10, the inspect_evals metric).
